title: CRDM Detect Output
description: The verdict on one request. `fires` is the decision; `categories` and `excluded` are the evidence for it, so a reviewer can see why it fired or why it did not.

fires.description: True when the request is flagged as a feature request: at least one detection category matched and no exclusion applied.

categories.description: The detection categories whose signals matched — the skill's `### ` sections. Empty when none did. Two or more from different categories is high confidence.

excluded.description: True when an exclusion applied (the request matched a signal but is not a feature request, e.g. a content edit). An excluded request does not fire.
